problem.title: Identify Consistent Summer Subscribers
problem.prompt: Your subscription box company wants to identify loyal customers who maintained their spending across the summer months of 2024. A customer qualifies if they spent at least $150 in June 2024 AND at least $150 in July 2024 (both months required). Write a query that returns the customer_id and customer_name of all qualifying customers. Orders are placed throughout each month, and a customer may have multiple orders per month. Only consider orders from June and July 2024; any spending in other months should not count toward these thresholds. Return results ordered by customer_id ascending. This analysis helps the marketing team identify high-value subscribers for an exclusive retention campaign.
problem.schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INT PRIMARY KEY, customer_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE subscription_orders (order_id INT PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INT NOT NULL, order_date DATE NOT NULL, order_amount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL);

composite_moves: join customers and subscription_orders on customer_id
extract month from order_date to categorize as June or July 2024
use SUM(CASE WHEN month = June THEN order_amount ELSE 0 END) >= 150 in HAVING
use SUM(CASE WHEN month = July THEN order_amount ELSE 0 END) >= 150 in HAVING

hints: You need to aggregate spending per customer and check thresholds for two specific months.
Use CASE expressions inside SUM to calculate separate totals for June and July within a single GROUP BY.
The HAVING clause should contain two conditions joined by AND, each checking a SUM(CASE ...) expression against the $150 threshold for its respective month.
problem.answer_key: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name FROM customers AS c JOIN subscription_orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= DATE '2024-06-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2024-07-01' THEN o.order_amount ELSE 0 END) >= 150 AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= DATE '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2024-08-01' THEN o.order_amount ELSE 0 END) >= 150 ORDER BY c.customer_id ASC;

_meta.scenario: a D2C subscription box service tracking renewal and churn

user_solution:
/* 
SPEND 150
JUNE 2024
JULY 2024

Write a query that returns the customer_id and customer_name of all qualifying customers.

Orders are placed throughout each month, and a customer may have multiple orders per month.
Only consider orders from June and July 2024; any spending in other months should not count toward these thresholds.
Return results ordered by customer_id ascending.
This analysis helps the marketing team identify high-value subscribers for an exclusive retention campaign.

*/

SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_name
FROM subscription_orders AS s
JOIN customers AS c
ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', s.order_date)::date = '2024-06-01' THEN s.order_amount ELSE 0 END) >= 150
    AND SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', s.order_date)::date = '2024-07-01' THEN s.order_amount ELSE 0 END) >= 150
ORDER BY customer_id;
